verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins ships digital self-serve tools (the LathamDrive document generator, the Automated Convertible Note generator, and the Book of Jargon app with a text search box), so a natural-language interface is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows only form-based document generation and keyword glossary search, not natural-language command operation. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI endpoints both returned 404.
